title: Kissed with Herbs Italian Grape Leaves Clay-pot-cooked
description: Savor the flavors of Puglia with this light and refreshing clay-pot-cooked dish featuring tender grape leaves and aromatic herbs. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a flavorful extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, white wine (if using), and bring to a simmer.
Add the grape leaves, fresh basil, and fresh parsley to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the pot with a lid and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the grape leaves are tender.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the grated parmesan cheese.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
